paragraphs: In this Annual Report, unless specifically stated otherwise or the context indicates otherwise, the terms the "Company," "DBRG," "DigitalBridge," "we," "our" and "us" refer to DigitalBridge Group, Inc. and its consolidated subsidiaries. References to the "Operating Company" and the "OP" refer to DigitalBridge Operating Company, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company and the operating company of DBRG, and its consolidated subsidiaries.

We are a leading global investment manager in digital infrastructure, deploying and managing capital across the digital ecosystem, including data centers, cell towers, and fiber networks. Our diverse global investor base includes public and private pensions, sovereign wealth funds, other asset managers, insurance companies, and endowments. At December 31, 2025, we had $41.0 billion of fee earning equity under management ("FEEUM").
Our head office is in Boca Raton, Florida, with key offices in New York, London, Luxembourg and Singapore. At December 31, 2025, we had 316 employees.

We operate as a taxable C Corporation and conduct substantially all of our activities and hold substantially all of our assets and liabilities through our Operating Company. As sole managing member, we own 97% of the Operating Company at December 31, 2025.

On December 29, 2025, DBRG, the Operating Company and indirect subsidiaries of SoftBank Group Corp. (TSE: 9984, "SoftBank") entered into an agreement and plan of merger (the "Merger Agreement") pursuant to which, among other things, DBRG and the Operating Company would be acquired by such indirect subsidiaries through a series of mergers (the "Merger").

SoftBank, through its indirect subsidiaries, will acquire all of (i) DBRG's issued and outstanding common stock and (ii) the OP common units that are not held by DBRG and the Operating Company (unless otherwise agreed by a holder of OP units and SoftBank through its indirect subsidiary), for $16.00 per share or per unit in cash. The preferred stock of DBRG and the Operating Company will remain outstanding. Warrants to purchase DBRG's common stock will be treated in accordance with the terms of the applicable warrant agreements.

Consummation of the Merger requires approval by DBRG's common stockholders, and is subject to certain other closing conditions, including receipt of required consents for the Company's flagship investment funds and from a specified percentage of fee-paying clients of the Company, and receipt of regulatory approvals, as well as customary closing conditions.

The Merger Agreement contains customary termination rights for both parties, including, among others, the right of either party to terminate the Merger Agreement if the Merger is not consummated on or before March 29, 2027, which may be extended by either party by up to 90 days if the closing conditions related to required regulatory approvals or absence of legal restraints prohibiting the Merger have not been satisfied or waived but all other conditions (other than those that by their nature are to be satisfied by actions taken at the closing) have been satisfied or waived. Under certain limited circumstances, the Company or SoftBank (through its indirect subsidiary) may be required to pay a termination fee of $96 million and $154 million, respectively, pursuant to the Merger Agreement in connection with such termination.

Subject to conditions set forth in the Merger Agreement, the Merger is expected to be completed in the second half of 2026. Following consummation of the Merger, the Company will become an indirect, wholly-owned subsidiary of SoftBank, but will continue to operate as a separately managed platform.

There can be no assurance that the Merger will be consummated. Risks and uncertainties associated with the Merger are discussed in Part I, Item 1A, "Risk Factors—Risks Related to the Merger" in this annual report on Form 10-K. All forward-looking statements herein do not take into account the impact of, or give any effect to, the Merger.
Additional information related to the Merger Agreement is included in our Current Report on Form 8-K filed on December 30, 2025.

Our investment management platform is anchored by our value-add funds within the DigitalBridge Partners ("DBP") infrastructure equity series. In providing institutional investors access to investments across different segments of the digital infrastructure ecosystem, our investment offerings have expanded to include core equity, credit and liquid securities.
•Our DBP series of commingled funds focus on value-add digital infrastructure, investing in and building businesses across the digital infrastructure sector.

•Core Equity invests in stabilized digital infrastructure platforms with long-duration cash flow profiles, primarily in more developed geographies, that offer consistent and predictable current yields, through our Strategic Assets Fund ("SAF").

headings: The Merger may not be completed on the terms or timeline currently contemplated or at all.
An adverse judgment in one or more lawsuits challenging the Merger, should they occur, may prevent the transaction from becoming effective or from becoming effective within the expected timeframe.
Failure to consummate the proposed Merger could have a material adverse impact on our business, results of operations and financial condition.

Uncertainty regarding the completion of the Merger may adversely impact our ability to maintain relationships with investors and business partners and may adversely affect our ability to attract and retain key employees.
The Merger Agreement contains provisions that could discourage a potential competing acquirer.
Our directors and executive officers have interests in the Merger that are different from, or in addition to, those of our other stockholders.
Difficult market and political conditions could adversely impact our business, financial condition and results of operations.
The investment management business is intensely competitive.
We depend on investors in the funds we manage for the continued success of our business.

Many parts of our revenues, earnings and cash flow are highly variable, which may make it difficult for us to achieve steady earnings growth on a quarterly basis, which may cause the price of our shares to be volatile.
Our investments in digital infrastructure may expose us to risks inherent in the ownership and operation of digital infrastructure.
Our investments in infrastructure assets, including through our InfraBridge funds, may expose us to increased risks that are inherent in the ownership of real assets.
Our operations in Europe, Asia, Latin America and other foreign markets expose our business to risks inherent in conducting business in foreign markets.
Rapid growth of our businesses, particularly outside the U.S., may be difficult to sustain and may place significant demands on our administrative, operational and financial resources.
The organization and management of our current and future investment vehicles may create conflicts of interest.
We may expand into new investment strategies, geographic markets and businesses, each of which may result in additional risks and uncertainties in our businesses.
We do not directly control the operations of our portfolio companies and are therefore dependent on portfolio company management teams to successfully operate their businesses.
paragraphs: The following risk factors and other information included in this Annual Report should be carefully considered. The risks and uncertainties described below are not the only ones we face. Additional risks and uncertainties not presently known to us that we currently deem immaterial or that generally apply to all businesses also may adversely impact our business. If any of the following risks occur, our business, financial condition, operating results, cash flow and liquidity could be materially adversely affected.

The consummation of the Merger is subject to certain closing conditions, including among other things: (a) the approval of the Company's stockholders; (b) expiration or early termination of the applicable waiting period under the Hart-Scott-Rodino Antitrust Improvements Act of 1976, as amended and the receipt of certain non-U.S. antitrust approvals; (c) the receipt of certain required consents or approvals, including, among others, from (i) the Committee on Foreign Investment in the United States and the applicable regulators in certain non-U.S. jurisdictions under foreign investment laws, (ii) the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission, (iii) the Federal Communications Commission, (iv) the Monetary Authority of Singapore, (v) the UK Financial Conduct Authority, and (vi) the European Union under the EU Foreign Subsidies Regulation 2022/2560; (d) the absence of legal restraints prohibiting the Merger; (e) the absence of certain materially adverse conditions or remedies imposed in connection with the foregoing regulatory approvals; and (f) the receipt of required consents for the Company's flagship investment funds and from fee-paying clients of the Company and its subsidiaries representing, in the aggregate, at least 85% of the base date revenue run rate of the fee-paying clients of the Company and its subsidiaries, as well as other customary closing conditions. There can be no assurance that such conditions will be satisfied in a timely manner or at all, or that an effect, event, development or change will not transpire that could delay or prevent these conditions from being satisfied. Governmental agencies may not approve the Merger or the related transactions necessary to complete the Merger or may impose conditions to the approval of such transactions or require changes to the terms of such transactions. Any such conditions or changes could have the effect of delaying completion of the Merger or imposing costs on or limiting the operation of the Company's business following the Merger, and such conditions or changes could lead to the termination of the Merger Agreement. Further, competing offers or acquisition proposals for the Company may be made, resulting in delay of the Merger or termination of the Merger Agreement.

Stockholders may file lawsuits challenging the Merger or the other transactions contemplated by the Merger Agreement, which may name the Company, members of the board of directors or others as defendants. No assurance can be made as to the outcome of such lawsuits, should they occur, including the amount of costs associated with defending these claims or any other liabilities that may be incurred in connection with the litigation of these claims. If plaintiffs are successful in obtaining an injunction prohibiting the parties from completing the Merger on the agreed-upon terms, such an injunction may delay the completion of the transaction in the expected timeframe, or may prevent the transaction from being completed altogether. Whether or not any plaintiff's claim is successful, this type of litigation may result in significant costs and diverts management's attention and resources, which could adversely affect the operation of our business.
In the event the Merger is not completed, we will be subject to a number of risks without realizing any of the benefits of having completed the Merger, including the following:
•We may be required to pay a termination fee of $93 million if the Merger is terminated under qualifying circumstances, as described in the Merger Agreement;
•We have incurred and will continue to incur substantial costs relating to the Merger, such as financial advisor, legal, and accounting fees, regardless of whether the Merger is completed;

paragraphs: The following discussion should be read in conjunction with our consolidated financial statements and accompanying notes thereto, which are included in Item 8. " Financial Statements and Supplementary Data " of this Annual Report.
The following summarizes significant developments that affected our business and results of operations in 2025.

•On December 29, 2025, DBRG entered into a definitive agreement to be acquired indirectly by SoftBank for $16.00 in cash per common share and OP common units that are not held by DBRG and the Operating Company (unless otherwise agreed by a holder of OP units and SoftBank through its indirect subsidiary). The transaction is expected to close in the second half of 2026, subject to approval by DBRG's common stockholders and other customary closing conditions. The preferred stock of DBRG and the Operating Company will remain outstanding. Warrants to purchase DBRG's common stock will be treated in accordance with the terms of the applicable warrant agreements.

•In 2025, we raised $5.6 billion of capital, primarily for DigitalBridge Partners III ("DBP III"), our third flagship digital infrastructure fund which had its final closing on October 31, 2025, and various co-investment vehicles.
DBP III fund commitments totaled $7.2 billion, inclusive of $150 million of our commitments as general partner and general partner affiliate.

•In connection with our participation in a secondary sale of equity by our DataBank portfolio company in February 2025, we received proceeds of approximately $59.7 million, representing $34.0 million realized principal investment income, $24.8 million return of capital and our share of carried interest of $0.9 million.

paragraphs: 本年度年報中，除非另有明確說明或上下文另有指示，否則「本公司」、「DBRG」、「DigitalBridge」、「我們」、「我們的」及「我們」均指 DigitalBridge Group, Inc. 以及其合併子公司。有關「營運公司」及「OP」的參考，則指 DigitalBridge Operating Company, LLC，為一家設立於德國的有限責任公司，為 DBRG 的營運公司，以及其合併子公司。
本公司為全球領先的數位基礎建設投資管理公司，在數位生態系統中部署並管理資本，包括資料中心、電塔及光纖網路。我們的多元全球投資者基礎包含公共與私人退休金、主權財富基金、其他資產管理公司、保險公司及捐助基金。於2025年12月31日，本公司管理的費用產生權益資本為41.0 十億美元（"FEEUM"）。
我們的總部設於佛羅裏達州博卡羅訥，並在紐約、倫敦、盧森堡及新加坡設有重要辦事處。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，我們共有 316 名員工。
我們以課稅 C 股權公司形式運作，並透過營運公司進行幾乎所有活動，持有幾乎所有資產與負債。作為唯一管理成員，我們於 2025 年 12 月 31 日持有營運公司 97% 的權益。
2025 年 12 月 29 日，DBRG、營運公司及 SoftBank Group Corp.（東京證券交易所代碼：9984，"SoftBank"）的間接子公司簽訂了合併協議（"合併協議"），根據該協議，DBRG 及營運公司將透過一系列合併方式被該間接子公司收購（"合併"）。
SoftBank 透過其間接子公司，將以每股或每單位 16.00 美元現金，收購 DBRG 發行在外的所有普通股，以及 OP 普通單位中不為 DBRG 及營運公司持有的部分（除非持有人與 SoftBank 透過其間接子公司另有協議）。DBRG 及營運公司的優先股將繼續存續。有關購買 DBRG 普通股的選擇權，將依照適用的選擇權協議條款處理。
合併的完成需經 DBRG 普通股股東批准，並受某些其他關閉條件限制，包括取得本公司旗艦投資基金的必要同意，以及取得指定比例的費用產生客戶的同意，以及取得監管批准，以及常見的關閉條件。

合併協議包含雙方的常見終止權，包括，但不僅限於，任一方在 2027 年 3 月 29 日或之前未能完成合併，則可終止合併協議，此期限可由任一方延長最多 90 天，前提是與取得必要監管批准或不存在禁止合併的法律限制相關的關閉條件未被滿足或放棄，但所有其他條件（除那些在關閉時必須履行的條件外）已滿足或放棄。在某些有限情況下，本公司或 SoftBank（透過其間接子公司）可能根據合併協議支付終止費用，分別為 96 百萬美元及 154 百萬美元。
依合併協議所設定之條件，本次合併預期將於2026年下半年完成。合併完成後，本公司將成為SoftBank間接且完全擁有之子公司，但將繼續作為獨立管理之平台運作。
無法保證本次合併將會完成。與本次合併相關之風險與不確定性，已於本10-K年度報告第一部分第1A項「風險因素—與合併相關之風險」中討論。本文件中所有向前看之陳述，均未考量或反映本次合併之影響。
與本次合併協議相關之額外資訊，已包含於本公司於2025年12月30日提交之Form 8-K現況報告中。
我們之投資管理平台以DigitalBridge Partners（"DBP"）基礎設施權益系列內之價值加成基金為核心。透過提供機構投資人對數位基礎設施生態系不同領域之投資管道，我們之投資產品已擴展至包含核心權益、信貸及流動性證券。
•DBP系列之混合基金專注於價值加成之數位基礎設施，投資並建立數位基礎設施領域之企業。
•核心權益投資於穩定之數位基礎設施平台，具長週期現金流特性，主要於較發達之地理區域，透過我們之戰略資產基金（"SAF"）提供穩定且可預測之現金收益。

paragraphs: 下列討論應與我們的合併財務報表及其附註一併閱讀，這些財務報表及附註包含於本年度報告第 8 項 "財務報表與補充資料" 中。
下列為影響我們業務與營運成果在 2025 年的重要發展事項總結。
•於 2025 年 12 月 29 日，DBRG 與 SoftBank 籤訂最終協議，將間接收購 DBRG，每股普通股及非由 DBRG 及運營公司持有的 OP 普通單位，以現金 16.00 美元兌換。交易預計於 2026 年第二季完成，需經 DBRG 普通股股東批准及其他慣例完成條件。DBRG 及運營公司的優先股將繼續流通。購買 DBRG 普通股的選擇權將依照適用的選擇權協議條款處理。
•在 2025 年，我們籌集了 5.6 十億美元的資金，主要用於 DigitalBridge Partners III（"DBP III"），我們第三個旗艦數位基礎設施基金，該基金於 2025 年 10 月 31 日完成最終關閉，以及各種共同投資工具。
DBP III 基金承諾總計為 7.2 十億美元，包含我們作為普通合夥人及普通合夥人附屬機構承諾的 150 百萬美元。
•配合我們參與 2025 年 2 月 DataBank 投資組合公司的二次股權出售，我們收到約 59.7 百萬美元的資金，其中包含 34.0 百萬美元實現的本金投資收入、24.8 百萬美元本金回報，以及我們應得的攜帶利益 0.9 百萬美元。
我們以下呈現 FEEUM，這是替代投資管理產業中一個關鍵營運指標。我們計算 FEEUM 的方式可能與其他投資管理公司不同，因此可能無法直接與其他投資管理公司所呈現的類似指標比較。
FEEUM 代表本公司及其附屬機構所管理的總資產，這些資產產生費用收入。FEEUM 通常基於承諾資本、投資資本、淨資產價值（"NAV"）或總資產價值（"GAV"），依照每項基礎投資管理協議的條款計算。

下表總結 FEEUM 之變動：
(1) 資金流入包括新募資完成且費用基於承諾資本、資金部署且費用基於投資資本、新訂閱且費用基於淨資產價值、其他投資資本變動如 recapitalization 和 syndication 之影響，以及從取得之投資機構所產生之 FEEUM。
(2) 資金流出包括流動策略之贖回與提領、費用基於投資資本之實現、其他投資資本變動如 recapitalization 和 syndication 之影響、費用基於承諾資本轉為投資資本之變動、投資價值之永久減損，以及費用支付資本之到期。

headings: 合併可能無法依照目前預期的條件或時間表完成，或根本無法完成。
若發生一個或多個挑戰合併的訴訟案件且判決對本公司不利，可能會導致交易無法生效或無法在預期時間內生效。
無法完成預期的合併，可能對我們的業務、營運結果及財務狀況造成重大不利影響。
關於合併能否完成的不確定性，可能影響我們維持與投資人及商業夥伴關係的能力，也可能對我們吸引及留住關鍵員工的能力產生不利影響。
合併協議包含一些條款，可能會阻卻潛在競爭買家的買盤。
我們的董事及高階管理人員在合併中有利益，這些利益可能與我們其他股東的利益不同，或在這些利益之外。
與我們業務相關的風險
困難的市場與政治環境可能對我們的業務、財務狀況及營運成果產生不利影響。
投資管理業務具有高度競爭性。
我們依賴所管理基金的投資人，以維持業務的持續成功。
我們許多收入、獲利與現金流的部分，具有高度變動性，這可能使我們難以每季實現穩定的獲利成長，這可能導致本公司股價波動。
我們在數位基礎建設的投資，可能使我們面臨擁有與營運數位基礎建設的內在風險。
我們在基礎建設資產的投資，包括透過 InfraBridge 基金，可能使我們面臨擁有實體資產的內在風險增加。
我們在歐洲、亞洲、拉丁美洲及其他外國市場的業務運作，使我們的業務面臨在異國市場營運的內在風險。
我們業務的快速成長，特別是在美國以外的地區，可能難以持續，且可能對我們的行政、運營及財務資源造成重大壓力。
本公司目前及未來投資工具之組織與管理可能產生利益衝突。
本公司可能拓展至新的投資策略、地理市場及業務領域，每項均可能導致本公司業務產生額外風險與不確定性。
本公司並未直接控制投資_portfolio_公司之營運，因此依賴投資_portfolio_公司管理團隊成功運作其業務。
paragraphs: 下列風險因素及其他資訊包含於本年度報告中，應謹慎考量。上述所描述的風險與不確定性並非我們唯一面臨的風險。尚有其他風險與不確定性，目前我們尚未知悉，或認為不重要，或普遍適用於所有企業，也可能對我們的業務產生不利影響。若上述任何風險發生，可能對我們的業務、財務狀況、營運結果、現金流量與流動性產生重大不利影響。

合併交易的完成需符合若干關閉條件，包括但不限於：(a) 本公司股東的批准；(b) 1976 年哈特-斯科特-羅迪諾反壟斷改進法案（Hart-Scott-Rodino Antitrust Improvements Act of 1976）經修正後適用的等待期屆滿或提前終止，並取得某些非美國反壟斷審批；(c) 取得某些必要的同意或批准，包括但不限於：(i) 美國對外投資委員會（Committee on Foreign Investment in the United States）及某些非美國司法管轄區根據外國投資法規的相關主管機關，(ii) 聯邦能源管理委員會（Federal Energy Regulatory Commission），(iii) 聯邦通訊委員會（Federal Communications Commission），(iv) 新加坡金融管理局（Monetary Authority of Singapore），(v) 英國金融行為監管局（UK Financial Conduct Authority），以及 (vi) 歐盟根據 2022 年外國補貼法規（EU Foreign Subsidies Regulation 2022/2560）的相關主管機關；(d) 沒有法律限制禁止該合併；(e) 沒有某些重大不利條件或補救措施被施加於前述審批程序；以及 (f) 取得本公司旗艦投資基金及本公司及其子公司費收客戶所需的必要同意，這些費收客戶合計代表本公司及其子公司費收客戶在基準日收入跑率的至少 85%，以及其他慣例關閉條件。無法保證這些條件會在合理時間內或任何時候得到滿足，或不會發生任何事件、發展或變動，可能延遲或阻止這些條件得到滿足。政府機構可能不會批准該合併或相關交易以完成該合併，或可能對批准這些交易施加條件，或要求修改這些交易的條款。任何這些條件或修改都可能導致延遲完成該合併，或對本公司業務在合併後的運作造成成本或限制，且這些條件或修改可能導致合併協議終止。此外，可能提出競爭性要約或收購提案，導致延遲該合併或終止該合併協議。

股東可能提出訴訟質疑該合併或合併協議所預期的其他交易，這些訴訟可能將本公司、董事會成員或其他人列為被告。無法保證這些訴訟的結果，包括防禦這些聲請的費用或任何其他可能因這些聲請的訴訟而產生的責任。若原告成功取得禁止當事人按協議條款完成該合併的禁制令，則可能延遲該交易在預期時間內完成，或完全阻止該交易完成。無論原告的聲請是否成功，這類訴訟可能導致重大成本，並分散管理階層的注意力與資源，這可能對我們業務的運作產生不利影響。
若該合併未完成，我們將面臨若干風險，而無法實現完成該合併的任何好處，包括以下內容：
• 若該合併因符合資格的情況而終止，我們可能需支付 93 百萬美元的終止費用；
• 我們已產生並將繼續產生與該合併相關的重大成本，例如財務顧問、法律及會計費用，無論該合併是否完成；
